implementation: Batch schema 3 records a sequential claimed-line count. Line schema 1 preserves account, batch, ordinal, input digest, and stable request identity.
Claim and current running batch state participate in one atomic comparison and write. A completed cancellation prevents subsequent claims across replicas.
Only an acknowledged new claim authorizes runner invocation. A retained claim never authorizes another execution, including after a lost write acknowledgment.
Repository mutation preserves original input, caller identity, endpoint, creation time, and claimed count. Claims have no automatic expiry.
The production line runner uses the retained request identity. Its existing current-policy check and router admission remain mandatory.
